news_cards.title: Bihar Mein 51600 Karod Rupye Ka Nivesh: Steel, Textile Aur Nuclear Energy Sector Ko Milenge Naye Aavashyak Sudhar
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye hain, jiske tahat 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga.
Is nivesh se Bihar mein steel, textile aur nuclear energy sector ko naye aavashyak sudhar milenge, jisse rajya ki arthvyavastha ko badhava milega.
Bihar sarkar ka uddeshya hai ki ve rajya ko viksit aur samriddh banayein, jiske liye ve naye nivesh aur udyogon ko badhava dena chahti hai.

bullets: Bihar sarkar ne JP Ganga Path ko vishwastariya swaroop dena ka nirnay liya hai, jiske tahat 65 kilometer ganga channel ka vikas hoga.
